title: Knuckle Drag
description: A designed FM bass-knock: a dry, clicky sub-kick whose pitch-envelope snaps down into the low register on every hit. Over 32 cycles the FM index swells and the harmonicity steps through ratios while a ladder filter and a hard-drive amount creep up, so the knock mutates from a tight tap into a distorted, grinding thud and back.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 [f1 f1] f1 c1 f1 [~ f1] eb1>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(2, 11)).fmh("<0.5 1 2 1.5>/8")
    .penv(sine.slow(32).range(28, 40)).pattack(0.001).pdecay("<0.04 0.06 0.05>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(16).range(180, 1900)).resonance(13).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(28).range(1, 4)).lpattack(0.003).lpdecay(0.07)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.16).sustain(0).release(0.04)
    .shape(sine.slow(20).range(0.2, 0.55)).distort("<0 0.3 0.6 0.2>/8")
    .coarse("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .off(1/16, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.22).pan(0.65).hpf(400))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.4, 0.6))
    .room(0.12).gain(0.95)
)
